keep-the-judgment.reason: Before you delegate: make the purpose and constraints explicit.
At the decision: separate helpful assistance from choices to keep personal.

trustworthy-tools.reason: Beyond correctness: include checking, cleanup, and maintenance in the cost.
Beyond the test: decide which parts of the work still need your judgment.

decision-quality.reason: Work through a fictional poker hand without letting the outcome rewrite the decision.
Before choosing between options, decide what you want the choice to serve.

generous-explanations.reason: Put the reader first as you turn a rough idea into a small, shareable version.
When the words belong to someone else, preserve their voice and permission.

learning-from-the-beginning.reason: Practice with AI without skipping the part you need to understand yourself.
Use an independent check to tell the difference between agreement and understanding.

finishing-is-a-decision.reason: Choose a manageable scope and a finish line before adding more.
After the work: leave space for an afternoon that does not need another project.
